blocks.zh: 第8章C部分：除菌過濾、成型充填密封、吹塑充填密封、冷凍乾燥與密閉系統
blocks.en: Chapter 8, Part C: Sterilising Filtration, Form-Fill-Seal, Blow-Fill-Seal, Lyophilisation and Closed Systems

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解除菌過濾器（Sterilising Grade Filter，0.22 µm）的系統設計原則，以及 PUPSIT（使用前滅菌後完整性測試）的法規強制要求與豁免條件
blocks.en: Understand the system design principles for sterilising grade filters (0.22 µm), and the mandatory requirement for PUPSIT (pre-use post-sterilisation integrity testing) and the conditions under which it may be waived

blocks.zh: 掌握成型充填密封 Form-Fill-Seal (FFS) 和吹塑充填密封 Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS) 的環境分級要求、關鍵製程參數（CPP）差異及無菌保證策略
blocks.en: Understand the environmental grading requirements, the differences in critical process parameters (CPPs) and the sterility assurance strategy for Form-Fill-Seal (FFS) and Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS)

blocks.zh: 了解冷凍乾燥機（Lyophilizer）滅菌頻率決策邏輯、裝載區設計要求，以及 8.123 條款延後實施的背景
blocks.en: Understand the decision logic for lyophiliser sterilisation frequency, the design requirements for the loading area, and the background to the deferred implementation of clause 8.123

blocks.zh: 理解密閉系統（Closed System）的定義、無菌連接設計原則，以及在無菌製程中降低污染風險的策略
blocks.en: Understand the definition of a closed system, the design principles for aseptic connections, and strategies for reducing contamination risk in aseptic processing

blocks.zh: 8.79–8.95 Sterilisation by Filtration — 除菌過濾滅菌
blocks.en: 8.79–8.95 Sterilisation by Filtration

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 除菌過濾系統
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Sterilising Filtration Systems

blocks.zh: 除菌過濾器（Sterilising Grade Filter）：孔徑最大 0.22 µm，經驗證可截留微生物，是無法終端滅菌（Terminal Sterilisation）產品的最後一道無菌保障。
blocks.en: Sterilising grade filter: a filter with a nominal pore size of 0.22 µm or smaller that has been validated to retain microorganisms. It is the last line of sterility assurance for products that cannot be terminally sterilised.

blocks.zh: 微生物負荷前過濾器（Bioburden Reduction Prefilter）：置於除菌過濾器上游，用於降低液體中微生物負荷（Bioburden），減少最終除菌過濾器的負擔，延長濾器壽命並提高整體無菌保障。
blocks.en: Bioburden reduction prefilter: placed upstream of the sterilising grade filter to reduce the bioburden of the liquid, lessen the load on the final sterilising filter, extend filter life and improve overall sterility assurance.

blocks.zh: 系統設計原則（8.82）：除菌過濾系統必須最小化除菌後到灌裝前的無菌連接（Aseptic Connection）數量——每一個連接點都是潛在的污染風險。
blocks.en: System design principle (8.82): a sterilising filtration system must minimise the number of aseptic connections between the sterilising filter and filling. Every connection point is a potential contamination risk.

blocks.zh: 吸附與浸出（Adsorption & Leaching）：濾器本身可能吸附藥物活性成分（影響濃度），或將濾器材料中的化學物質溶出至產品中——這兩者都必須評估。
blocks.en: Adsorption & leaching: the filter itself may adsorb the active ingredient (affecting concentration) or release chemicals from the filter materials into the product. Both must be assessed.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 除菌過濾的「最後安全門」
blocks.en: Analogy: Sterilising Filtration as the "Last Security Gate"

blocks.zh: 將除菌過濾系統想像成機場的安全通道：前段的行李 X 光機（bioburden reduction prefilter）先篩掉大件危險品；最後的人工安檢（0.22 µm 除菌濾器）才是正式的「放行確認」。Annex 1 要求這道最後安全門要盡可能靠近登機口（point of fill）——距離越短，安檢後被重新污染的風險越低。
blocks.en: Think of a sterilising filtration system as airport security. The baggage X-ray machine at the front end (the bioburden reduction prefilter) screens out the large dangerous items first, and the final manual check (the 0.22 µm sterilising filter) is the formal "clearance to proceed". Annex 1 requires this last security gate to be as close to the boarding gate (the point of fill) as possible: the shorter the distance, the lower the risk of re-contamination after the check.

blocks.zh: ★ 重大條款：PUPSIT（8.87）— 使用前滅菌後完整性測試
blocks.en: ★ Key Clause: PUPSIT (8.87), Pre-Use Post-Sterilisation Integrity Testing

blocks.zh: PUPSIT = Pre-Use Post-Sterilization Integrity Test（使用前滅菌後完整性測試）
blocks.en: PUPSIT = Pre-Use Post-Sterilisation Integrity Test

blocks.zh: 濾器滅菌（通常是高壓蒸氣或 gamma 照射）後、使用前，必須先做一次完整性測試（integrity test），確認濾器在安裝與滅菌過程中未受損。過去許多廠商只做使用後測試（post-use），2022 年版 Annex 1 明確要求使用前也需測試。
blocks.en: After the filter has been sterilised (usually by autoclave or gamma irradiation) and before use, an integrity test must be performed to confirm that the filter was not damaged during installation and sterilisation. In the past many manufacturers performed only post-use testing; the 2022 version of Annex 1 explicitly requires testing before use as well.

blocks.zh: 測試方法：起泡點法（Bubble Point）、擴散流法（Diffusive Flow）、水浸入法（Water Intrusion）、壓力保持法（Pressure Hold Test）
blocks.en: Test methods: bubble point, diffusive flow, water intrusion and pressure hold test

blocks.zh: 豁免條件：僅在有充分科學依據且完成徹底風險評估後方可豁免（例如極小體積過濾），且必須有補償性控制措施。
blocks.en: Conditions for waiver: only where there is sound scientific justification and a thorough risk assessment has been completed (for example, very small filtration volumes), and compensating controls must be in place.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — PUPSIT：出門前檢查瓦斯
blocks.en: Analogy: PUPSIT Is Like Checking the Gas Before You Leave Home

blocks.zh: PUPSIT 就像出門前檢查瓦斯爐是否關好：瓦斯爐（濾器）可能在安裝時就已損壞，如果不事先檢查，等到你回家（使用後才測試）發現問題，整批藥品可能已無菌保障全失。
blocks.en: PUPSIT is like checking that the gas stove is off before leaving the house. The stove (the filter) may already have been faulty when it was installed. If you do not check beforehand and only find the problem when you come home (testing only after use), the sterility assurance for the whole batch of product may already be lost.

blocks.zh: 以前的做法是：用完才測試（post-use only）——萬一那批藥品過濾時濾器就已破損，整批放行都是無效的無菌保障。PUPSIT 就是要在「使用前」就確認濾器完好。
blocks.en: The old practice was to test only after use (post-use only). If the filter was already breached when that batch was filtered, the sterility assurance behind the release of the whole batch was invalid. PUPSIT confirms that the filter is intact before use.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 使用後完整性測試（Post-Use）同樣必要
blocks.en: Key Point: Post-Use Integrity Testing Is Equally Necessary

blocks.zh: 8.87 也要求除菌濾器在過濾完成後、拆除前，必須做使用後完整性測試（Post-Use Integrity Test）。這是確認「過濾過程中濾器是否完整」的最終確認。兩個測試缺一不可：
blocks.en: 8.87 also requires the sterilising filter to undergo a post-use integrity test after filtration is complete and before the filter is removed. This is the final confirmation that the filter remained intact during filtration. Neither test can be omitted:

blocks.zh: Pre-use（PUPSIT）：確認濾器在滅菌與安裝時未損壞
blocks.en: Pre-use (PUPSIT): confirms the filter was not damaged during sterilisation and installation

blocks.zh: Post-use：確認過濾過程中濾器始終完整
blocks.en: Post-use: confirms the filter remained intact throughout filtration

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 冗餘過濾系統（8.92）
blocks.en: Key Concept: Redundant Filtration System (8.92)

blocks.zh: 冗餘過濾系統（Redundant Filtration System）：安裝兩個串聯的除菌濾器，但驗證僅需一個即可達到無菌保障。第二個（備用）濾器是安全保障。
blocks.en: Redundant filtration system: two sterilising filters installed in series, although validation requires only one of them to achieve sterility assurance. The second (back-up) filter is a safeguard.

blocks.zh: 實務邏輯：若主過濾器（primary）通過使用後完整性測試，備用過濾器（redundant）不需測試。若主過濾器測試失敗，則對備用過濾器進行測試，同時啟動調查。這代表只要備用濾器完整，批次放行仍有可能。
blocks.en: Practical logic: if the primary filter passes the post-use integrity test, the redundant filter does not need to be tested. If the primary filter fails, the redundant filter is tested and an investigation is started at the same time. This means that, as long as the redundant filter is intact, batch release may still be possible.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 微生物負荷採樣時機（8.93）
blocks.en: Key Point: Timing of Bioburden Sampling (8.93)

blocks.zh: 微生物負荷（Bioburden）採樣必須在最終除菌過濾「緊接之前（immediately prior to）」執行。若為冗餘系統，則在第一個濾器前採樣。
blocks.en: Bioburden sampling must be performed "immediately prior to" the final sterilising filtration. For a redundant system, the sample is taken before the first filter.

blocks.zh: 目的：確認進入除菌濾器的液體微生物負荷在可接受範圍內，作為無菌保障的輸入控制（input control）。高微生物負荷可能堵塞或損壞濾器，增加過濾失敗風險。
blocks.en: Purpose: to confirm that the bioburden of the liquid entering the sterilising filter is within acceptable limits, as an input control for sterility assurance. High bioburden may block or damage the filter and increase the risk of filtration failure.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 濾器一次性使用原則（8.94）
blocks.en: Key Point: Single-Use Principle for Filters (8.94)

blocks.zh: 除菌液體濾器原則上僅供單批次使用，且同一濾器不得連續使用超過一個工作天，除非經過驗證。
blocks.en: As a rule, a sterilising liquid filter is used for a single batch only and the same filter must not be used for more than one working day, unless this has been validated.

blocks.zh: 例外情況（8.95）：連續生產（Campaign Manufacture）場景下，可在充分評估、記錄風險並完成驗證後，使用更長時間。但必須明確規定最大驗證使用期限，並嚴格管控。
blocks.en: Exception (8.95): in campaign manufacture, a longer period of use is possible after adequate assessment, documented risk evaluation and validation. The maximum validated period of use must be clearly defined and tightly controlled.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application — CDMO 的 PUPSIT 實施挑戰
blocks.en: Practical Application: PUPSIT Implementation Challenges at a CDMO

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，PUPSIT 帶來實際挑戰：
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, PUPSIT brings practical challenges:

blocks.zh: 設備設計：過濾系統必須設計成允許在滅菌後、充填前進行完整性測試的能力（通常需要增加壓力感測器和閥門）
blocks.en: Equipment design: the filtration system must be designed so that an integrity test can be performed after sterilisation and before filling (this usually requires additional pressure sensors and valves)

blocks.zh: SOP 更新：2022 年版 Annex 1 發布後，現有 SOP 必須更新，並對操作人員重新培訓
blocks.en: SOP updates: after the 2022 version of Annex 1 was published, existing SOPs must be updated and operators retrained

blocks.zh: 豁免申請：小批量客戶產品若無法進行 PUPSIT，需要正式的書面風險評估，並在 CCS 中記錄補償性控制措施
blocks.en: Waiver requests: for small-batch client products where PUPSIT cannot be performed, a formal documented risk assessment is needed, and the compensating controls must be recorded in the CCS

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: PUPSIT 與傳統的「使用後完整性測試（post-use integrity test）」有何本質差異？為何 Annex 1 (2022) 認為只做使用後測試是不夠的？
blocks.en: What is the essential difference between PUPSIT and the traditional post-use integrity test? Why does Annex 1 (2022) consider testing only after use to be insufficient?

blocks.zh: 一家製造商表示他們的產品體積極小（5 mL），難以執行 PUPSIT。他們應如何處理此情況？需要哪些文件？
blocks.en: A manufacturer states that its product volume is very small (5 mL) and that PUPSIT is difficult to perform. How should this situation be handled? What documentation is needed?

blocks.zh: 在冗餘過濾系統中，若主濾器失敗了使用後完整性測試，批次是否必然被拒絕？說明決策流程。
blocks.en: In a redundant filtration system, if the primary filter fails the post-use integrity test, must the batch be rejected? Explain the decision process.

blocks.zh: 8.96–8.104 Form-Fill-Seal (FFS) — 成型充填密封
blocks.en: 8.96–8.104 Form-Fill-Seal (FFS)

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — FFS 技術
blocks.en: Key Concepts: FFS Technology

blocks.zh: 成型充填密封（Form-Fill-Seal, FFS）：一種整合式包裝技術，使用卷膜（web film）在同一機台上完成容器成型（forming）、藥液充填（filling）、密封（sealing）和切割（cutting）。常見於輸液軟袋、眼藥水等。
blocks.en: Form-Fill-Seal (FFS): an integrated packaging technology that uses a web film to carry out container forming, product filling, sealing and cutting on a single machine. It is commonly used for soft infusion bags, eye drops and similar products.

blocks.zh: 終端滅菌 vs 無菌充填的分級差異：
blocks.en: Difference in grading between terminally sterilised and aseptically filled products:

blocks.zh: 終端滅菌（Terminally Sterilised）產品的 FFS：遵循 8.3/8.4 條款（背景區域要求）
blocks.en: FFS for terminally sterilised products: follow clauses 8.3/8.4 (background environment requirements)

blocks.zh: 無菌充填（Aseptic Manufacture）的 FFS：遵循 8.10 條款（Grade A 充填區）
blocks.en: FFS for aseptic manufacture: follow clause 8.10 (grade A filling zone)

blocks.zh: 這是 FFS 在法規上最關鍵的區分點——同樣的設備，使用場景不同，環境要求截然不同。
blocks.en: This is the most critical regulatory distinction for FFS: the same equipment has very different environmental requirements depending on the use case.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — FFS 像生產線上的「自動包裝機」
blocks.en: Analogy: FFS Is Like an "Automatic Packing Machine" on a Production Line

blocks.zh: FFS 就像便利商店的三明治自動包裝機：原料（薄膜）從一端進入，在同一台機器上自動完成成型、填料、密封。藥廠的 FFS 機台的核心挑戰是：密封品質（sealing quality）取決於溫度、壓力、時間的精確控制——任何一個參數偏差都可能導致密封不完全，直接危害藥品無菌性和穩定性。
blocks.en: FFS is like the automatic sandwich packing machine in a convenience-store supplier: the raw material (film) enters at one end, and forming, filling and sealing are completed automatically on the same machine. The core challenge of a pharmaceutical FFS machine is that seal quality depends on precise control of temperature, pressure and time. A deviation in any one parameter can lead to an incomplete seal, directly endangering the sterility and stability of the product.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 包裝薄膜的生物負荷控制（8.97）
blocks.en: Key Point: Bioburden Control of the Packaging Film (8.97)

blocks.zh: FFS 的包裝薄膜（packaging film）是無菌保障鏈中的關鍵輸入材料。Annex 1 要求：
blocks.en: The packaging film used in FFS is a critical input material in the sterility assurance chain. Annex 1 requires that:

blocks.zh: 薄膜的 Bioburden（微生物負荷）和 endotoxin/pyrogen 水平必須被定義和管控
blocks.en: The bioburden and endotoxin/pyrogen levels of the film must be defined and controlled

blocks.zh: 這些控制要納入 PQS（產品品質系統）和 CCS（污染控制策略）
blocks.en: These controls must be incorporated into the PQS (pharmaceutical quality system) and the CCS (contamination control strategy)

blocks.zh: 薄膜的厚度、強度、完整性、artwork 都必須符合規格
blocks.en: The thickness, strength, integrity and artwork of the film must all meet specification

blocks.zh: 這意味著薄膜供應商管理是 FFS 無菌保障的重要環節，不能只管製程本身。
blocks.en: This means that film supplier management is an important part of FFS sterility assurance; it is not enough to control only the process itself.

blocks.zh: FFS 關鍵製程參數（CPP）摘要
blocks.en: Summary of FFS Critical Process Parameters (CPPs)

blocks.zh:
FFS CPP 矩陣（8.101）：
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
成型參數：
  - 成型溫度（預熱/冷卻）
  - 成型時間與壓力
  - 包裝尺寸均一性

密封參數（最關鍵）：
  - 密封溫度（上下均一性）
  - 密封時間與壓力
  - 密封強度測試（每批次）

充填參數：
  - 充填體積、速度、均一性
  - 批號印刷/壓印設定

品質確認：
  - 100% 密封完整性測試（8.22）
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
blocks.en:
FFS CPP matrix (8.101):
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Forming parameters:
  - Forming temperature (pre-heating/cooling)
  - Forming time and pressure
  - Uniformity of container dimensions

Sealing parameters (most critical):
  - Sealing temperature (upper/lower uniformity)
  - Sealing time and pressure
  - Seal strength test (every batch)

Filling parameters:
  - Fill volume, speed and uniformity
  - Batch number printing/embossing settings

Quality confirmation:
  - 100% seal integrity testing (8.22)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 接受 FFS 新客戶的評估重點
blocks.en: Practical Application: Key Points for a CDMO Assessing a New FFS Client

blocks.zh: 當 CDMO 評估一個新的 FFS 客戶專案時，需優先確認：
blocks.en: When a CDMO evaluates a new FFS client project, the following should be confirmed first:

blocks.zh: 終端滅菌 or 無菌充填？ 決定了環境監控等級和 CCS 複雜度
blocks.en: Terminal sterilisation or aseptic filling? This determines the environmental monitoring grade and the complexity of the CCS

blocks.zh: 包裝薄膜規格：客戶提供的薄膜是否有符合 Annex 1 要求的 Bioburden/endotoxin COA？
blocks.en: Packaging film specification: does the film supplied by the client have a bioburden/endotoxin COA that meets Annex 1 requirements?

blocks.zh: 密封驗證：目前 FFS 機台的密封溫度/壓力驗證報告（PQ）是否涵蓋客戶的薄膜規格？
blocks.en: Seal validation: does the existing seal temperature/pressure validation report (PQ) for the FFS machine cover the client's film specification?

blocks.zh: CCS 整合：客戶的包裝薄膜管控是否已整合進廠內的 CCS 文件？
blocks.en: CCS integration: has the client's packaging film control been integrated into the site's CCS document?

blocks.zh: FFS 用於終端滅菌產品與無菌充填產品，在環境分級上有何不同？為什麼？
blocks.en: How do the environmental grading requirements differ between FFS for terminally sterilised products and FFS for aseptically filled products? Why?

blocks.zh: 一個 FFS 批次發現有部分容器密封強度低於規格。依 8.103/8.104，應如何處理？需要哪些文件？
blocks.en: In one FFS batch, some containers were found with seal strength below specification. How should this be handled under 8.103/8.104? What documentation is required?

blocks.zh: 為何 FFS 的包裝薄膜需要控制 endotoxin/pyrogen 水平（8.97）？這與產品品質有何關聯？
blocks.en: Why must the endotoxin/pyrogen level of FFS packaging film be controlled (8.97)? How does this relate to product quality?

blocks.zh: 8.105–8.120 Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS) — 吹塑充填密封
blocks.en: 8.105–8.120 Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS)

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — BFS 技術特性
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Characteristics of BFS Technology

blocks.zh: 吹塑充填密封（Blow-Fill-Seal, BFS）：從聚合物顆粒（polymer granulate）出發，在同一機台上完成：擠出（extrusion）→ 吹塑成型（blow-moulding）→ 充填（filling）→ 密封（sealing）。整個過程不依賴預製容器，是高度整合的無菌充填技術。
blocks.en: Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS): starting from polymer granulate, a single machine carries out extrusion → blow-moulding → filling → sealing. The process does not rely on pre-made containers, making it a highly integrated aseptic filling technology.

blocks.zh: 兩種主要機型：
blocks.en: Two main machine types:

blocks.zh: 往復式（Shuttle Type）：型胚（parison）在成型時對外部環境開放，關鍵區域需達 Grade A
blocks.en: Shuttle type: the parison is open to the external environment during forming, so the critical zone must be grade A

blocks.zh: 旋轉式（Rotary Type）：型胚成型後通常在封閉環境中，但旋轉結構使關鍵充填區的環境監控較為困難
blocks.en: Rotary type: the parison is usually in an enclosed environment after forming, but the rotating structure makes environmental monitoring of the critical filling zone more difficult

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — BFS 像「現場鑄瓶立刻裝藥」
blocks.en: Analogy: BFS Is Like "Casting the Bottle on the Spot and Filling It Immediately"

blocks.zh: BFS 就像一家礦泉水工廠：塑膠顆粒進來，機器先把它熔化、吹成瓶子（blow-moulding），瓶口還沒完全冷卻就立刻注入水，然後立刻密封。整個過程在幾秒內完成，容器從未暴露在外部環境中。
blocks.en: BFS is like a mineral water factory: plastic granules go in, and the machine melts them and blows them into a bottle (blow-moulding). While the bottle neck has not yet fully cooled, water is injected immediately and the bottle is sealed straight away. The whole process takes a few seconds, and the container is never exposed to the external environment.

blocks.zh: 這就是 BFS 無菌保障的核心優勢：容器「出生」的瞬間就被充填和密封，幾乎沒有機會被污染。但代價是：高溫擠出和切割過程產生大量微粒，使得「在線粒子監控」（in operation total particle monitoring）幾乎不可能——Annex 1 在 8.107 明確認可了這一點。
blocks.en: This is the core sterility assurance advantage of BFS: the container is filled and sealed at the very moment it is "born", leaving almost no opportunity for contamination. The trade-off is that high-temperature extrusion and cutting generate large numbers of particles, which makes in-operation total particle monitoring almost impossible. Annex 1 explicitly recognises this in 8.107.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — BFS 的粒子監控豁免（8.107）
blocks.en: Key Point: Exemption from Particle Monitoring for BFS (8.107)

blocks.zh: 8.107 是 Annex 1 中少見的「承認監控限制」條款：由於 BFS 製程本身會產生大量聚合物擠出和切割微粒，加上充填關鍵區空間狹小，不要求進行充填過程中的總粒子數監控（in-operation total particle monitoring）。
blocks.en: 8.107 is one of the few clauses in Annex 1 that acknowledges a monitoring limitation: because the BFS process itself generates large numbers of polymer extrusion and cutting particles, and the critical filling zone is small, in-operation total particle monitoring during filling is not expected.

blocks.zh: 但這不代表完全免除責任——廠商必須有設計驗證數據（design qualification data），証明設備設計確保關鍵充填區在運作時能達到 Grade A 條件。
blocks.en: This does not mean responsibility is removed entirely. The manufacturer must hold design qualification data demonstrating that the equipment design ensures the critical filling zone achieves grade A conditions during operation.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 聚合物顆粒的無菌保障（8.112）
blocks.en: Key Point: Sterility Assurance of Polymer Granulate (8.112)

blocks.zh: BFS 的無菌保障不只在製程端——原料端的聚合物顆粒（polymer granulate）同樣需要被管控。Annex 1 要求：
blocks.en: Sterility assurance for BFS does not lie only in the process; the polymer granulate on the raw material side must also be controlled. Annex 1 requires that:

blocks.zh: 擠出系統對成型容器提供無菌保障的能力必須被理解和驗證
blocks.en: The ability of the extrusion system to provide sterility assurance for the formed container must be understood and validated

blocks.zh: 原始聚合物的微生物負荷（bioburden）和內毒素（endotoxin/pyrogen）水平必須被定義和管控
blocks.en: The bioburden and endotoxin/pyrogen levels of the raw polymer must be defined and controlled

blocks.zh: 這些控制要整合進 PQS 和 CCS
blocks.en: These controls must be integrated into the PQS and CCS

blocks.zh: 高溫擠出過程本身提供了一定的熱殺菌效果，但這必須被明確驗證，而不能僅憑假設。
blocks.en: The high-temperature extrusion process itself provides some thermal sterilising effect, but this must be explicitly validated and cannot simply be assumed.

blocks.zh: BFS 環境要求對比表
blocks.en: Comparison of BFS Environmental Requirements

blocks.zh:
終端滅菌產品的 BFS（8.105）：
  背景環境：最低 Grade D
  充填點：符合 8.3/8.4 要求

無菌充填的 BFS（8.106）：
  往復式設備（Shuttle Type）：
    關鍵區（擠出/吹塑/密封）：Grade A
    背景環境：最低 Grade C（著 A/B 潔淨服）
  旋轉式設備（Rotary Type）：
    型胚內充填環境：Grade A
    背景環境：最低 Grade C（著 A/B 潔淨服）

在線粒子監控（8.107）：
  不要求 in-operation 總粒子監控
  但需設計驗證數據支持 Grade A 達成
blocks.en:
BFS for terminally sterilised products (8.105):
  Background environment: minimum grade D
  Point of fill: meets the requirements of 8.3/8.4

BFS for aseptic filling (8.106):
  Shuttle type equipment:
    Critical zone (extrusion/blow-moulding/sealing): grade A
    Background environment: minimum grade C (with A/B cleanroom garments)
  Rotary type equipment:
    Filling environment inside the parison: grade A
    Background environment: minimum grade C (with A/B cleanroom garments)

In-operation particle monitoring (8.107):
  In-operation total particle monitoring is not expected
  But design qualification data is needed to support achievement of grade A

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 模具是關鍵設備（8.120）
blocks.en: Key Concept: Moulds Are Critical Equipment (8.120)

blocks.zh: BFS 的模具（moulds）被明確定義為關鍵設備（critical equipment）。任何對模具的變更或修改，都必須：
blocks.en: BFS moulds are explicitly defined as critical equipment. Any change or modification to the moulds must:

blocks.zh: 對成品容器完整性進行重新評估
blocks.en: Trigger a reassessment of the integrity of the finished container

blocks.zh: 若評估結果顯示有影響，必須進行驗證
blocks.en: Be followed by validation if the assessment shows an impact

blocks.zh: 這是因為模具直接決定容器壁厚、容量和密封品質，模具的任何磨損或修改都可能改變這些關鍵參數，進而影響容器的密封完整性（CCI）和無菌性。
blocks.en: This is because the mould directly determines container wall thickness, volume and seal quality. Any wear or modification of the mould may change these critical parameters and in turn affect container closure integrity (CCI) and sterility.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — BFS 在 CDMO 的客戶論證
blocks.en: Practical Application: Justifying BFS to Clients at a CDMO

blocks.zh: CDMO 向新客戶展示 BFS 技術的無菌保障時，需要能夠解釋：
blocks.en: When a CDMO presents the sterility assurance of its BFS technology to a new client, it needs to be able to explain:

blocks.zh: 設計驗證（DQ）如何証明充填關鍵區達到 Grade A（即使無法做在線監控）
blocks.en: How design qualification (DQ) demonstrates that the critical filling zone achieves grade A (even though in-operation monitoring is not possible)

blocks.zh: 聚合物顆粒供應商如何管控 bioburden，以及廠內如何驗證儲存和分配系統
blocks.en: How polymer granulate suppliers control bioburden, and how the site validates its storage and distribution systems

blocks.zh: 模具變更管理流程（Change Control），包括何時觸發容器完整性重新驗證
blocks.en: The mould change control process, including when re-validation of container integrity is triggered

blocks.zh: 在線 100% 容器完整性測試（CCI）方法及其與 8.22 的合規性
blocks.en: The in-line 100% container closure integrity (CCI) test method and its compliance with 8.22

blocks.zh: 為何 BFS 設備的往復式（shuttle type）和旋轉式（rotary type）在無菌充填場景下的環境要求不同？解釋背後的技術原因。
blocks.en: Why do the environmental requirements for shuttle type and rotary type BFS equipment differ in aseptic filling? Explain the technical reasons.

blocks.zh: 8.107 說 BFS 在運作時「不要求（not expected）」總粒子監控。這是否意味著廠商對充填區環境品質完全沒有責任？
blocks.en: 8.107 states that total particle monitoring during BFS operation is "not expected". Does this mean the manufacturer has no responsibility at all for the environmental quality of the filling zone?

blocks.zh: BFS 加蓋（caps）操作（8.118）在無菌充填和終端滅菌場景下有何不同要求？為什麼？
blocks.en: How do the requirements for BFS capping operations (8.118) differ between aseptic filling and terminal sterilisation? Why?

blocks.zh: 8.121–8.126 Lyophilization — 冷凍乾燥
blocks.en: 8.121–8.126 Lyophilisation

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 冷凍乾燥的無菌延伸性
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Lyophilisation as an Extension of the Aseptic Process

blocks.zh: 冷凍乾燥（Lyophilization）：在低溫真空環境下，將藥品中的水分從固態冰直接昇華為水蒸氣，以去除水分並延長藥品穩定性。冷凍乾燥機（Lyophilizer）是整個無菌製程的延伸——充填完成的半加蓋瓶（partially stoppered vials）仍處於「未封口」狀態，直到冷凍乾燥完成後才真正完成密封。
blocks.en: Lyophilisation (freeze-drying): under low temperature and vacuum, water in the product is sublimated directly from solid ice to water vapour, removing moisture and extending product stability. The lyophiliser is an extension of the whole aseptic process: partially stoppered vials that have been filled remain "unsealed" and are only truly closed once lyophilisation is complete.

blocks.zh: 8.121 明確定義：冷凍乾燥是無菌製程的延伸（extension of aseptic processing）。這代表所有裝載、轉移、卸載操作都必須維持與無菌充填相同等級的污染控制。
blocks.en: 8.121 explicitly defines lyophilisation as an extension of aseptic processing. This means that all loading, transfer and unloading operations must maintain the same level of contamination control as aseptic filling.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 冷凍乾燥機是「無菌製程的延伸手術室」
blocks.en: Analogy: The Lyophiliser Is the "Extended Operating Theatre" of the Aseptic Process

blocks.zh: 冷凍乾燥機就像手術室的一個「後備室」：手術（充填）完成後，病人（半加蓋瓶）還需要在另一個無菌空間（冷凍乾燥機）繼續接受治療（乾燥），期間傷口（瓶口）仍然暴露，無菌環境的要求一刻都不能鬆懈。
blocks.en: A lyophiliser is like a "recovery room" attached to an operating theatre: after the operation (filling) is finished, the patient (the partially stoppered vials) still needs to continue treatment (drying) in another sterile space (the lyophiliser). Throughout this time the wound (the vial opening) remains exposed, and the sterile environment requirements cannot be relaxed for a moment.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼冷凍乾燥機本身需要定期滅菌，且從充填站到冷凍乾燥機的轉移路徑必須全程維持 Grade A 條件。
blocks.en: This is why the lyophiliser itself needs to be sterilised regularly, and why the transfer path from the filling station to the lyophiliser must maintain grade A conditions throughout.

blocks.zh: 延後實施通知 — 8.123 條款（重要！）
blocks.en: Deferred Implementation Notice: Clause 8.123 (Important!)

blocks.zh: 8.123 條款中關於「手動裝載無屏障冷凍乾燥機須在每次裝載前進行滅菌」的要求，已推遲至 2024 年 8 月 25 日實施。
blocks.en: The requirement in clause 8.123 that a manually loaded lyophiliser without barrier technology must be sterilised before each loading has been deferred to 25 August 2024.

blocks.zh: 原始 Annex 1 (2022) 要求：手動裝載/卸載且無屏障技術分隔的冷凍乾燥機，須在每次裝載前滅菌。對於許多尚未自動化的廠房，這是一個重大的操作負擔，PIC/S 給予了緩衝期。
blocks.en: The original Annex 1 (2022) required lyophilisers that are manually loaded/unloaded without barrier separation to be sterilised before each load. For many sites that are not yet automated, this is a major operational burden, and PIC/S therefore granted a grace period.

blocks.zh: 實務含義：廠商應檢視目前的冷凍乾燥機裝載方式，評估是否符合此要求，並將滅菌頻率決策明確記錄於 CCS 中。如果仍是手動裝載無屏障，應在 2024 年 8 月 25 日前完成合規改善或文件更新。
blocks.en: Practical implication: manufacturers should review how their lyophilisers are currently loaded, assess whether they meet this requirement, and clearly document the sterilisation frequency decision in the CCS. If loading is still manual without barriers, compliance improvements or documentation updates should be completed before 25 August 2024.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 冷凍乾燥機完整性測試（8.124）
blocks.en: Key Point: Lyophiliser Integrity Testing (8.124)

blocks.zh: 冷凍乾燥機的完整性（integrity）管控包含兩個層面：
blocks.en: Integrity control of a lyophiliser has two aspects:

blocks.zh: 濾器完整性：用於維持冷凍乾燥機完整性的過濾器必須在每次使用前滅菌，且其完整性測試結果必須作為批次放行（batch certification/release）的一部分
blocks.en: Filter integrity: filters used to maintain the integrity of the lyophiliser must be sterilised before each use, and the results of their integrity tests must form part of batch certification/release

blocks.zh: 腔體真空/洩漏完整性：腔體的真空/洩漏完整性測試頻率必須文件化，且每個循環開始前必須確認最大允許洩漏量（maximum permitted leakage）
blocks.en: Chamber vacuum/leak integrity: the frequency of chamber vacuum/leak integrity testing must be documented, and the maximum permitted leakage must be confirmed before the start of each cycle

blocks.zh: 這意味著冷凍乾燥機的完整性測試結果是批次放行的必要文件，不是選擇性監控。
blocks.en: This means that lyophiliser integrity test results are required documents for batch release, not optional monitoring.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 裝載設計與半加蓋瓶保護（8.126）
blocks.en: Key Point: Loading Design and Protection of Partially Stoppered Vials (8.126)

blocks.zh: 8.126 列出了冷凍乾燥機裝載設計的關鍵考量點，核心原則是：
blocks.en: 8.126 lists the key considerations for lyophiliser loading design. The core principles are:

blocks.zh: 半加蓋瓶從充填站到冷凍乾燥機的轉移必須全程在 Grade A 下進行
blocks.en: Transfer of partially stoppered vials from the filling station to the lyophiliser must take place under grade A throughout

blocks.zh: 未封口容器必須與操作人員進行物理屏障隔離
blocks.en: Unsealed containers must be physically separated from operators by a barrier

blocks.zh: 所有接觸冷凍乾燥機的器具（托盤、夾具、鑷子等）必須是無菌的
blocks.en: All items that contact the lyophiliser (trays, fixtures, forceps, etc.) must be sterile

blocks.zh: 冷凍乾燥機腔體開門後，若塞子尚未完全壓入，產品必須繼續在 Grade A 下處理
blocks.en: After the lyophiliser chamber is opened, if the stoppers have not yet been fully pressed in, the product must continue to be handled under grade A

blocks.zh: 冷凍乾燥機滅菌頻率決策樹
blocks.en: Decision Tree for Lyophiliser Sterilisation Frequency

blocks.zh:
問題：冷凍乾燥機如何裝載/卸載？
        │
        ├── 手動裝載，無屏障技術隔離
        │     → 每次裝載前滅菌（8.123）
        │       [注意：此要求延後至 2024/08/25 實施]
        │
        └── 自動化系統 OR 封閉屏障系統保護
              → 滅菌頻率可調整
                但必須：
                - 有科學依據
                - 記錄於 CCS
                - 定期審查

另外，以下情況必須重新滅菌（8.122）：
  - 維護（Maintenance）後
  - 清潔（Cleaning）後
blocks.en:
Question: How is the lyophiliser loaded/unloaded?
        │
        ├── Manual loading, no barrier technology separation
        │     → Sterilise before every load (8.123)
        │       [Note: this requirement is deferred to 25 Aug 2024]
        │
        └── Automated system OR closed barrier system protection
              → Sterilisation frequency can be adjusted
                but it must be:
                - Scientifically justified
                - Recorded in the CCS
                - Reviewed periodically

In addition, re-sterilisation is required in the following cases (8.122):
  - After maintenance
  - After cleaning

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 冷凍乾燥機升級投資評估
blocks.en: Practical Application: Assessing Lyophiliser Upgrade Investments

blocks.zh: 8.123 的要求促使許多 CDMO 重新評估手動冷凍乾燥機的改造投資：
blocks.en: The requirement in 8.123 has prompted many CDMOs to reassess the investment case for upgrading manual lyophilisers:

blocks.zh: 現狀評估：手動裝載無屏障系統 → 每批前滅菌 → 增加生產時間和蒸汽消耗
blocks.en: Current state: manual loading without barrier → sterilise before every batch → more production time and steam consumption

blocks.zh: 升級選項：安裝自動裝載系統（automated loading system）或 RABS/Isolator 屏障 → 可降低滅菌頻率，提高生產效率
blocks.en: Upgrade options: install an automated loading system or an RABS/isolator barrier → sterilisation frequency can be reduced and production efficiency improved

blocks.zh: ROI 計算：節省的滅菌時間 × 批次數量 × 設備利用率 vs 升級資本支出
blocks.en: ROI calculation: sterilisation time saved × number of batches × equipment utilisation vs upgrade capital expenditure

blocks.zh: CCS 更新：無論升級與否，滅菌頻率的決策依據必須明確記錄於 CCS
blocks.en: CCS update: whether or not the upgrade goes ahead, the rationale for the sterilisation frequency must be clearly documented in the CCS

blocks.zh: 為何冷凍乾燥過程被定義為「無菌製程的延伸（extension of aseptic processing）」而不是獨立製程步驟？這對環境要求有何影響？
blocks.en: Why is the lyophilisation process defined as an "extension of aseptic processing" rather than a stand-alone process step? What is the impact on environmental requirements?

blocks.zh: 一家工廠的冷凍乾燥機目前是手動裝載，沒有屏障技術。根據 8.123，他們目前的操作是否合規？他們有哪些選項？
blocks.en: A site's lyophiliser is currently loaded manually with no barrier technology. Is its current practice compliant with 8.123? What options does it have?

blocks.zh: 冷凍乾燥機的完整性測試結果（8.124）必須作為批次放行文件的一部分。請說明這在批次記錄（Batch Record）中應如何被記錄。
blocks.en: Lyophiliser integrity test results (8.124) must form part of the batch release documentation. Explain how this should be recorded in the batch record.

blocks.zh: 8.127–8.130 Closed Systems — 密閉系統
blocks.en: 8.127–8.130 Closed Systems

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 密閉系統定義
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Definition of a Closed System

blocks.zh: 密閉系統（Closed System）：在無菌製程中，指一個與外部環境完全隔離的液體處理系統，產品不暴露於周圍環境。典型例子：無菌轉移管路、一次性使用袋（Single-Use Bag）系統、整合式過濾充填管路。
blocks.en: Closed system: in aseptic processing, a liquid handling system that is completely isolated from the external environment, so that the product is not exposed to the surrounding environment. Typical examples: sterile transfer tubing, single-use bag systems and integrated filtration-filling lines.

blocks.zh: 密閉系統的三大保護優勢：
blocks.en: Three main protective benefits of closed systems:

blocks.zh: 降低微生物污染（microbial contamination）風險
blocks.en: Reduced risk of microbial contamination

blocks.zh: 降低微粒污染（particle contamination）風險
blocks.en: Reduced risk of particle contamination

blocks.zh: 降低化學污染（chemical contamination）風險
blocks.en: Reduced risk of chemical contamination

blocks.zh: 設計核心原則：最小化手動操作（minimize manual manipulations）。每次人工介入都是污染風險的增加點。
blocks.en: Core design principle: minimise manual manipulations. Every human intervention increases the risk of contamination.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 密閉系統像「封閉式輸血管路」
blocks.en: Analogy: A Closed System Is Like a "Closed Transfusion Line"

blocks.zh: 密閉系統就像醫院的靜脈輸液管路：從血袋到患者手臂的整條路徑都是封閉的，血液（藥液）在整個轉移過程中不暴露於空氣。如果需要在中途接上另一條管路（aseptic connection），必須使用特殊的無菌連接裝置（sterile connector），而不能打開系統暴露在空氣中。
blocks.en: A closed system is like a hospital intravenous infusion line: the whole path from the blood bag to the patient's arm is closed, and the blood (the product) is never exposed to air during transfer. If another line needs to be connected midway (an aseptic connection), a special sterile connector must be used; the system must not be opened to the air.

blocks.zh: 8.128 的核心要求就是：除菌濾器後的管路連接，必須使用能保持系統無菌的連接方式（例如 sterile weld 或 aseptic connector），不能用普通的螺紋接頭或手動打開連接。
blocks.en: The core requirement of 8.128 is that connections downstream of the sterilising filter must use a method that keeps the system sterile (for example a sterile weld or an aseptic connector), not an ordinary threaded fitting or a manually opened connection.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 無菌連接設備（8.128/8.129）
blocks.en: Key Point: Aseptic Connection Devices (8.128/8.129)

blocks.zh: 在除菌濾器後的所有管路連接必須設計為「本質上無菌（intrinsically sterile）」的連接方式。常見的合規解決方案：
blocks.en: All connections downstream of the sterilising filter must be designed as "intrinsically sterile" connections. Common compliant solutions include:

blocks.zh: 無菌焊接（Sterile Weld / Tube Welding）：使用熱融焊接技術在封閉環境中連接管路，連接點本身就是無菌的
blocks.en: Sterile weld (tube welding): tubing is joined in a closed environment using thermal welding technology, so the connection point itself is sterile

blocks.zh: 無菌快速連接器（Aseptic Connector）：設計為可在非無菌環境下連接但保持連接點無菌的專用接頭
blocks.en: Aseptic connector: a dedicated connector designed so that the connection can be made in a non-sterile environment while keeping the connection point sterile

blocks.zh: Rapid Transfer Port (RTP)：快速傳遞口，用於密閉系統之間的無菌轉移
blocks.en: Rapid Transfer Port (RTP): a rapid transfer port used for aseptic transfer between closed systems

blocks.zh: 供應商評估（supplier assessment）必須包含潛在失效模式（failure modes）的數據收集，這是 CCS 的必要輸入。
blocks.en: Supplier assessment must include the collection of data on potential failure modes. This is a necessary input to the CCS.

blocks.zh: 密閉系統背景環境決策矩陣（8.130）
blocks.en: Decision Matrix for the Background Environment of Closed Systems (8.130)

blocks.zh:
問題：密閉系統應放置在何種環境分級？
        │
        ├── 無菌製程 AND 有任何系統完整性被破壞的風險
        │     → Grade A
        │
        ├── 無菌製程 AND 可通過壓力測試/監控
        │   證明系統在每次使用時均保持完整
        │     → 可使用較低分級區域
        │       （但需評估並文件化）
        │
        └── 密閉系統被開啟（如：維護）：
              - 終端滅菌製程 → Grade C
              - 無菌製程     → Grade A
              OR
              進行清潔、消毒（無菌製程需加上滅菌）
blocks.en:
Question: In which environmental grade should a closed system be placed?
        │
        ├── Aseptic process AND any risk that system integrity is breached
        │     → Grade A
        │
        ├── Aseptic process AND it can be shown by pressure testing/monitoring
        │   that the system remains intact at every use
        │     → A lower grade area may be used
        │       (but this must be assessed and documented)
        │
        └── Closed system is opened (e.g. for maintenance):
              - Terminally sterilised process → Grade C
              - Aseptic process     → Grade A
              OR
              Perform cleaning and disinfection (plus sterilisation for aseptic processes)

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 密閉系統評估在 CDMO 的商業意義
blocks.en: Practical Application: The Commercial Significance of Closed System Assessment at a CDMO

blocks.zh: 密閉系統設計的好壞直接影響 CDMO 的競爭力：
blocks.en: The quality of a closed system design directly affects a CDMO's competitiveness:

blocks.zh: 背景環境降級的可能性：如果能夠充分論證密閉系統的完整性（8.130），可能將操作從 Grade A 降至較低分級，顯著降低環境監控成本和複雜度
blocks.en: Potential to downgrade the background environment: if the integrity of the closed system can be adequately justified (8.130), operations may be moved from grade A to a lower grade, significantly reducing the cost and complexity of environmental monitoring

blocks.zh: 供應商選擇：無菌連接器、焊接設備的選擇直接影響系統完整性——需要供應商提供失效模式數據（failure mode data）作為 CCS 的輸入
blocks.en: Supplier selection: the choice of aseptic connectors and welding equipment directly affects system integrity, so suppliers need to provide failure mode data as an input to the CCS

blocks.zh: 一次性使用系統（SUS）整合：SUS 本質上是密閉系統的延伸，8.127-8.130 的要求對 SUS 的設計選型有直接指導意義（參見 8.131-8.139）
blocks.en: Integration of single-use systems (SUS): SUS are essentially an extension of closed systems, and the requirements of 8.127-8.130 give direct guidance for SUS design and selection (see 8.131-8.139)

blocks.zh: 密閉系統（8.127）如何改變傳統無菌製程的污染控制策略？它能否完全取代嚴格的環境分級要求？
blocks.en: How do closed systems (8.127) change the contamination control strategy of a traditional aseptic process? Can they fully replace strict environmental grading requirements?

blocks.zh: 根據 8.130，一個密閉系統的背景環境在什麼條件下可以從 Grade A 降級到較低分級？需要哪些文件支持？
blocks.en: Under 8.130, under what conditions can the background environment of a closed system be downgraded from grade A to a lower grade? What documentation is needed to support this?

blocks.zh: 若在無菌製程中需要開啟密閉系統進行維護，應在何種環境分級下進行？事後需要做什麼？
blocks.en: If a closed system must be opened for maintenance during an aseptic process, in which environmental grade should this be done? What must be done afterwards?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section 8C Summary
blocks.en: Section 8C Summary

blocks.zh: 除菌過濾（8.79-8.95）：PUPSIT（使用前滅菌後完整性測試）是 Annex 1 (2022) 的強制要求，豁免須有充分風險評估和補償控制；微生物負荷採樣必須在最終過濾前緊接執行；除菌濾器原則上單批次使用
blocks.en: Sterilising filtration (8.79-8.95): PUPSIT (pre-use post-sterilisation integrity testing) is a mandatory requirement of Annex 1 (2022); a waiver requires a sound risk assessment and compensating controls; bioburden sampling must be performed immediately before the final filtration; a sterilising filter is, as a rule, used for a single batch only

blocks.zh: FFS（8.96-8.104）：終端滅菌與無菌充填適用不同環境分級；包裝薄膜的 Bioburden/endotoxin 控制必須納入 PQS 和 CCS；密封溫度均一性是最關鍵的 CPP
blocks.en: FFS (8.96-8.104): terminally sterilised and aseptically filled products are subject to different environmental grades; bioburden/endotoxin control of the packaging film must be incorporated into the PQS and CCS; sealing temperature uniformity is the most critical CPP

blocks.zh: BFS（8.105-8.120）：高溫擠出製程免除在線總粒子監控要求，但需設計驗證數據；原始聚合物的微生物負荷也需管控；模具是關鍵設備，任何修改需重新評估容器完整性
blocks.en: BFS (8.105-8.120): because of the high-temperature extrusion process, in-operation total particle monitoring is not expected, but design qualification data is required; the bioburden of the raw polymer must also be controlled; moulds are critical equipment, and any modification requires reassessment of container integrity

blocks.zh: 冷凍乾燥（8.121-8.126）：冷凍乾燥是無菌製程的延伸，全程需維持無菌條件；8.123 手動裝載每批前滅菌要求已延後至 2024 年 8 月 25 日實施；冷凍乾燥機完整性測試結果是批次放行必要文件
blocks.en: Lyophilisation (8.121-8.126): lyophilisation is an extension of the aseptic process and sterile conditions must be maintained throughout; the 8.123 requirement to sterilise before each batch when loading manually has been deferred to 25 August 2024; lyophiliser integrity test results are required documents for batch release

blocks.zh: 密閉系統（8.127-8.130）：除菌濾器後的管路連接必須使用本質上無菌的連接方式（如無菌焊接、無菌連接器）；密閉系統可在論證完整性後使用較低分級背景環境
blocks.en: Closed systems (8.127-8.130): connections downstream of the sterilising filter must use intrinsically sterile methods (such as sterile welds or aseptic connectors); a closed system may use a lower-grade background environment once its integrity has been justified

blocks.zh: 決策層次提醒 Decision Hierarchy
blocks.en: Decision Hierarchy

blocks.zh: 1. 無菌保證 Sterility Assurance — 永遠第一
blocks.en: 1. Sterility Assurance: always first

blocks.zh: 2. 產品關鍵品質屬性 CQAs — 患者安全
blocks.en: 2. Product critical quality attributes (CQAs): patient safety

blocks.zh: 3. 商業與操作彈性 Business Flexibility — 最後考量
blocks.en: 3. Business flexibility: the last consideration

blocks.zh: 本節所有技術選擇（PUPSIT、環境分級、滅菌頻率、密閉系統設計）都必須以無菌保證為最高優先。
blocks.en: All technical choices in this section (PUPSIT, environmental grading, sterilisation frequency, closed system design) must give top priority to sterility assurance.
